de: Former Empress Matilda, daughter and designated heiress of king Henry I of England, marries Geoffrey Plantagenet, Count of Anjou.

t: 圣马梅德战役(Battle of São Mamede),位于吉马雷斯附近:由阿丰索一世所率领…
te: Forces led by Afonso I defeat forces led by his mother Teresa of León and her lover Fernando Pérez de Traba.
dz: 圣马梅德战役(Battle of São Mamede),位于吉马雷斯附近:由阿丰索一世所率领的部队击败由莱昂的母亲特蕾莎和她的情人费尔南多·佩雷斯·德特拉巴所率领的部队.
de: Battle of São Mamede, near Guimarães: Forces led by Afonso I defeat forces led by his mother Teresa of León and her lover Fernando Pérez de Traba.
